text:
Situation: Oxacillin sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 389 vials of the 1 g injection, providing 25.6 days on hand at current use. Corvale Lakeside holds 48 vials, providing 12.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include oxacillin sodium as of 2026-10-21. The rule‑based check found no FDA shortage posting before an action at a registered plant, so the state is classified as check.

Our position: Supply at General is adequate for the near term. Lakeside stock is lower and warrants monitoring. No FDA shortage declaration exists to trigger formal allocation protocols.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from current contracted suppliers; buyer approves.
2. Monitor Lakeside inventory weekly and transfer stock from General if days on hand fall below 14; buyer and pharmacy operations manager approve.
3. Qualify Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. as a backup source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
4. Qualify Onesource Specialty Pharma Limited as a secondary backup; buyer and P&T committee approve.
5. Review Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, and Wockhardt USA LLC only if primary and backup sources become unavailable; buyer and P&T committee approve.

Not recommended: Initiate emergency shortage procedures, restrict use, or change formulary status based on current data.
